template.name: Bean guide - Process (en)
template.p: Raw bean exports (HS code 1801 00 00 00) follow the Exports module process: contract, CCC sales confirmation and FO1 form, transit order (TO), lots, containers, B/L, D6, invoice, support or levy repayment. This guide only covers what is specific to beans; everything else is in the Exports guide.

ol.li: Processing batch: the site's outgoing weighing slip (site lot number, bags, gross, tare, net, quality, certification).
Bean TO and lot generation (one lot ≈ one container).
Build the lot: allocate bags from processing batches. The lot tonnage is the weighed net weight.
Stuffing, B/L, D6 as for any export.
Shipping documents of the B/L (phytosanitary, fumigation, origin, quality…).
EUDR: B/L dossier for the importer's due diligence statement.
Invoice, then an arrival claim if the buyer finds a weight loss or a quality defect.

ul.li: No factory production: lots are filled from processing batches, never by a "production".
The form conversion coefficient is 1: CCC levies are based on the bean tonnage.
In "beans only" mode (default), liquor, butter, cake and powder disappear from lists, and factory menus are hidden.

template.name: Bean guide - Processing batches (en)
template.p: lists processing batches; the Available filter shows those with bags left to allocate.

ol.li: Processing site, site lot number, weighing slip number, date.
Bags, gross weight and tare: the net is computed (gross − tare).
Certification (empty for conventional beans) and quality measurements (Quality measurements tab).
Confirm: only a confirmed batch can be allocated.

template.p: A weighing slip cannot be entered twice for the same site. Once allocated, the batch's weights, site and certification are locked.
: an .xlsx file whose columns are recognised by their header, in any order. Required: site lot number, site, date, gross weight. French numbers ("26 400,5") and dd/mm/yyyy dates are accepted.

ol.li: Download the template to start from scratch.
Analyse: each row is checked (site, certification, weights, duplicates); nothing is created.
Import the valid rows: as drafts, or confirmed if ticked. Rows in error are skipped; fix them in the file and run again.

template.name: Bean guide - Building lots (en)
template.p: From the export lot (), button Build the lot.

ol.li: Add one or more processing batches: only confirmed batches with the same certification as the lot are offered.
Enter the number of bags (bulk: kg). The allocated net is the weighed net pro rata to the bags; the last bags of a batch take its exact remainder.
Tick Full lot when the lot is full: its target becomes its actual weight and it moves to Ready for stuffing.

template.p: If the weight exceeds the lot target, Odoo refuses unless "Full lot" is ticked (50 t maximum per lot). The certification of a built lot can no longer be changed.

template.name: Bean guide - Quality (en)
template.p: A processing batch's measurements are assessed against two references of the beans module:

ul.li: the acceptance standard of its certification (otherwise the ordinary beans standard) → Compliant or Non-compliant;
the bean campaign's grade grid → Grade 1, Grade 2 or sub-grade, compared with the grade of the TO's sales confirmation.

template.p: Both are edited in and . After a change, click Re-assess on the batch.

tr.td: Findings are shown and logged on the lot; the allocation goes through.
The allocation is refused. A can override by ticking "Override the quality check" with a reason, logged on the lot.

template.name: Bean guide - Documents (en)
template.p: Each bean B/L () has an Export documents tab: one row per document with number, date, issuer and attachments. The status tells what is missing: Missing, Incomplete (number, date or scan), Out of validity, Complete.

Required documents are checked on B/L confirmation or invoice confirmation, depending on their setting: while one is missing, confirmation is refused and the message lists what is missing. Add missing documents completes the list if a type was added later.
The list and requirements are set in : when required, mandatory attachment, validity in days before shipment (fumigation), certified lots or EU destination only.

template.name: Bean guide - EUDR (en)
template.p: EUDR tab of the processing batch. Two ways to trace the beans:

ul.li: Source bean lots, when the upstream chain (purchases, plots) is tracked in Odoo: their eligibility prevails.

Supplied geolocation: the GeoJSON file provided by the site or cooperatives. Odoo checks it on upload (structure, coordinates in Côte d'Ivoire in [longitude, latitude] order, closed polygons). The batch stays To complete / check until a clicks Mark as verified. A new file cancels the verification.

template.p: The export lot takes the state of its batches and the B/L that of its lots. On an eligible B/L, Générer le dossier EUDR produces the GeoJSON (source plots and supplied plots) and the summary for the importer, who files the due diligence statement (DDS). Its reference and verification numbers are then entered on the B/L, which freezes the dossier.

template.name: Bean guide - Claims (en)
template.p: , or the B/L's Claims button. One open claim per B/L.
Shipped net weight, invoice and price per kg come from the B/L. Enter the landed net weight (arrival weight certificate):

ul.li: franchise = shipped net × franchise % (0.5% by default, configurable);
weight amount = (loss − franchise) × price per kg;
claimed amount = weight amount + quality amount (survey or arbitration).

ol.li: Submitted by the buyer: the agreed amount defaults to the claimed amount; adjust it after negotiation.
A Agrees (never above the claim) or Rejects.
Settlement: Issue the credit note opens the pre-filled credit note wizard (free amount, reason); or Settled (accounting entry) with the number and date of the accounting software entry.

65 kg jute bags, 1 kg tare; or bulk (in kg, no per-unit tare).

ol.li: Default currency and exchange rates (a foreign-currency invoice without a rate is refused).
Company identity and bank accounts.
Processing sites, certifications, customers, forwarders, ports.
Acceptance standards, campaign grade grid, required documents.
History import: contracts, sales confirmations, forms, TOs (Exports module wizards), then processing batches.

tr.td: "… n'est pas exporté par cette société (réglage Fèves uniquement)"
Choose "Fèves de cacao", or tick "Also export semi-finished products".
An export lot does not mix certifications: pick batches with the lot's certification.
"Le lot … atteindrait … T pour une cible de …"
Reduce the bags, or tick "Full lot".
Non-compliant batch or grade below the sales confirmation: use another batch, or ask a Manager for an override.
Complete the B/L's Export documents tab (number, date, scan, validity).
Latitude and longitude are often swapped in the GeoJSON: the expected order is [longitude, latitude].
